verdict.rationale: Swell documents an official Swell CLI for creating and working with apps, themes, and storefronts, with concrete commands such as `swell app init`, `swell app push`, and switching the default store. A probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Swell's AI page also says an installed agent picks up the CLI and its validate-deploy-verify loop, which ties the CLI to AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and documentation of agent-oriented CLI behaviour such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth.
